request.style: English, male solo voice, warm baritone, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, timpani, solemn and reverent, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Some time later Jesus went up
To Jerusalem for a festival
By the Sheep Gate there is a pool
Where five colonnades covered

[Verse]
Blind and lame and paralyzed
Lay in these places waiting
For the water to be stirred
So they might be healed

[Verse]
One man had been an invalid
For thirty-eight long years
Jesus saw him lying there
And asked if he wanted well

[Verse]
He had no one to help him in
When the water was stirred
While he was on his way
Someone else would go down first

[Verse]
Jesus said get up and pick up
Your mat and begin to walk
At once the man was made well
And began to walk away

[Verse]
The Jews said it was the Sabbath
You are not permitted to carry
But the man who made him well
Told him to pick it up

[Verse]
They asked who the man was
But he did not know who it was
Jesus had slipped away
Because there was a crowd

[Verse]
Later Jesus found him in the temple
And said see you have been made well
Sin no more or something worse
May happen to you

[Outro]
Pick up your mat and walk
